book_name: 托福雅思写作必备词组

words.tr: phrase. 正规教育；正规学校教育
words.ex: He missed formal schooling because he lived far from the school.
words.ex_cn: 他因为住得离学校太远而错过了正规教育。
words.en: Structured, institutionalized learning within a recognized educational system, typically leading to formal qualifications.

words.tr: phrase. 强制性的学校教育；义务的学校教育
words.ex: Compulsory schooling starts at age six in this country.
words.ex_cn: 在这个国家，义务教育从六岁开始。
words.en: Compulsory schooling refers to the period of education that is required by law for all children.

words.tr: phrase. 所有人都免费
words.ex: The museum is free of charge for all visitors.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆对所有游客免费。

words.tr: phrase. 中国的九年义务教育
words.ex: China's nine-year compulsory education includes primary and junior high school.
words.ex_cn: 中国的九年义务教育包括小学和初中。

words.tr: phrase. 合格的教师；具备资质的教师
words.ex: The school prides itself on its qualified teachers.
words.ex_cn: 学校以其百分百合格的师资为傲。
words.en: Educators who possess the necessary certifications, skills, and experience to teach effectively.

words.tr: phrase. 教师培训计划
words.ex: The government supports teacher training schemes to improve education.
words.ex_cn: 政府支持教师培训计划以提高教育质量。

words.tr: phrase. 传递事实
words.ex: The teacher imparts facts about history to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师向学生传递历史事实。

words.tr: phrase. 开始对……感兴趣
words.ex: He become interested in birds after watching a nature show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完一个自然节目后对鸟类产生了兴趣。
words.en: To start to feel interested in something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 对...感兴趣
words.ex: He takes an interest in birds.
words.ex_cn: 他对鸟类感兴趣。
words.en: To become interested in something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 对……失去兴趣
words.ex: He lost interest in playing guitar after a month.
words.ex_cn: 他一个月后对弹吉他失去了兴趣。

words.tr: phrase. 打消学生对某事的兴趣
words.ex: Too much homework can discourage students' interest in learning.
words.ex_cn: 太多作业会打消学生对学习的兴趣。

words.tr: phrase. 激发了学生对科学的兴趣
words.ex: The science fair encouraged students' interest in science.
words.ex_cn: 科学展览激发了学生对科学的兴趣。

words.tr: phrase. 培养学生对某事的兴趣
words.ex: The teacher uses games to foster students' interest in math.
words.ex_cn: 老师用游戏来培养学生对数学的兴趣。

words.tr: phrase. 培养学生对某事的兴趣
words.ex: Teachers should cultivate students' interest in science by doing fun experiments.
words.ex_cn: 老师应该通过做有趣的实验来培养学生对科学的兴趣。

words.tr: phrase. 培养学生对某事的兴趣
words.ex: The teacher uses games to develop students' interest in math.
words.ex_cn: 老师用游戏来培养学生对数学的兴趣。

words.tr: phrase. 组织实地考察
words.ex: The teacher will organize field trips to the museum next month.
words.ex_cn: 老师将在下个月组织去博物馆的实地考察。

words.tr: phrase. 塑造孩子的个性
words.ex: Parents can mould children's personality through love and discipline.
words.ex_cn: 父母可以通过爱与纪律来塑造孩子的个性。

words.tr: phrase. 个性的表达
words.ex: He wears bright clothes as an expression of his personality.
words.ex_cn: 他穿鲜艳的衣服，这是他个性的表达。

words.tr: phrase. 个性鲜明；有强烈个性
words.ex: She have a strong personality and always speaks her mind.
words.ex_cn: 她个性鲜明，总是直言不讳。

words.tr: v. 穿校服
words.ex: The students wear school uniform every day.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每天穿校服。
words.en: To wear the official clothing prescribed by a school for its students.

words.tr: phrase. 教育机会；学习和接受教育的可能性或途径
words.ex: Children in rural areas need more educational opportunities.
words.ex_cn: 农村的孩子需要更多的教育机会。
words.en: Educational opportunities refer to the chances or possibilities for individuals to receive education, which can include formal schooling, training programs, or other forms of learning.

words.tr: phrase. 接受教育的机会；获得教育的途径
words.ex: The program aims to improve access to education for children in remote areas.
words.ex_cn: 该计划旨在改善偏远地区儿童接受教育的机会。
words.en: The opportunity or right to receive education.

words.tr: phrase. 教育预算
words.ex: The government increased the education budget this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年政府增加了教育预算。

words.tr: n. 资金；基金；“fund”的复数；
words.ex: The school needs more funds to buy new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funds are amounts of money that are available to be spent, especially money that is set aside for a specific purpose.

words.tr: n. 投资
words.ex: He made an investment in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他投资了一家小企业。
words.en: An investment is an amount of money that you invest in something.

words.tr: phrase. 参加上课；上学
words.ex: He attends class every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上课。
words.en: To be present at a class or lecture as part of a course of study.

words.tr: phrase. 上课；有课
words.ex: We have class every Monday at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们每个星期一早上9点有课。
words.en: To be scheduled to attend a lesson or course.

words.tr: phrase. 参加讲座；听讲课
words.ex: He attends lectures every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都去听讲座。
words.en: Go to classes or talks given by a teacher or expert.

words.tr: phrase. 上大学；就读于大学
words.ex: He will attend university next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将上大学。
words.en: To go to a university to study for a degree.

words.tr: v. 接受高等教育
words.ex: He wants to receive higher education in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他想接受高等教育学习工程。
words.en: Obtain education beyond secondary school level.

words.tr: phrase. 高级课程；进阶课程
words.ex: He takes advanced courses in math and science.
words.ex_cn: 他上高级的数学和科学课程。
words.en: Courses that are at a higher level of difficulty or complexity, designed for students who have already mastered the basics.

words.tr: 短语动词. 获得实际操作经验；通过亲身实践来积累经验
words.ex: He gained hands-on experience by fixing cars with his father.
words.ex_cn: 他通过和父亲一起修车获得了实践经验。
words.en: To gain hands-on experience means to acquire practical experience by doing something rather than just reading about it or being told about it.

words.tr: phrase. 给学生提供实践操作经验
words.ex: The lab lets students give students practical hands-on experience with machines.
words.ex_cn: 实验室让学生通过机器获得实践操作经验。

words.tr: phrase. 具有动手操作计算机的经验
words.ex: He has hands-on experience of computers from fixing his old laptop.
words.ex_cn: 他通过修理旧笔记本电脑获得了动手操作计算机的经验。

words.w: people who hold a bachelor's degree
words.tr: phrase. 拥有学士学位的人
words.ex: Many people who hold a bachelor's degree find good jobs.
words.ex_cn: 许多拥有学士学位的人能找到好工作。

words.w: those with a high school diploma
words.tr: phrase. 拥有高中文凭的人
words.ex: Those with a high school diploma can apply for many entry-level jobs.
words.ex_cn: 拥有高中文凭的人可以申请许多初级工作。

words.tr: adj. 以考试为导向的；侧重考试的
words.ex: He is an exam-orientated student who only studies for tests.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个只为了考试而学习的应试型学生。
words.en: Focused on preparing for or achieving success in examinations.

words.tr: adj. 以考试为导向的
words.ex: This school is examination-oriented and focuses on test scores.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校以考试为导向，注重考试成绩。

words.tr: phrase. 远程教育
words.ex: He takes distance education classes from home.
words.ex_cn: 他从家里上远程教育课程。
words.en: A form of education in which the main elements include physical separation of teachers and students during instruction and the use of various technologies to facilitate student-teacher and student-student communication.

words.tr: phrase. 远程教育；远程教学
words.ex: He takes remote education from home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家接受远程教育。
words.en: Remote education refers to the process of teaching and learning conducted over the internet or through other digital means, without the need for physical presence in a traditional classroom setting.

words.tr: adj. 受过良好教育的
words.ex: He is a well-educated man who works at a university.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位受过良好教育的男子，在大学工作。
words.en: Someone who is well-educated has received a good education and has a lot of knowledge.

words.tr: n. 专门知识；专门技能；
words.ex: His expertise in computers helps the team solve problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机方面的专门知识帮助团队解决问题。
words.en: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice.

words.tr: phrase. 专业知识；专业技能知识
words.ex: He uses his professional knowledge to solve work problems.
words.ex_cn: 他运用自己的专业知识来解决工作问题。
words.en: Professional knowledge refers to the specialized knowledge and skills required in a particular profession or field of work.

words.tr: phrase. 学术资格；学历
words.ex: He needs an academic qualification to get the job.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一份学术资格才能获得这份工作。
words.en: An academic qualification is an official document showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study or passed an examination.

words.tr: phrase. 教育资格；学历；指通过学习和考试获得的学位、证书或文凭等证明
words.ex: Her educational qualification includes a master's degree in English literature.
words.ex_cn: 她的教育资格包括英语文学硕士学位。
words.en: An educational qualification is a proof of a person's education, usually in the form of a certificate or diploma.

words.tr: phrase. 学术表现；学业成绩
words.ex: His academic performance improved after he studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 他更努力学习后，学业表现提高了。
words.en: The achievement or success in academic studies or work, often measured by grades or other assessments.

words.tr: phrase. v. 习惯于；变得适应
words.ex: He got accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯了早起。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone so that it seems normal or usual.

words.tr: phrase. 习惯于
words.ex: He is getting used to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他正在习惯早起。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone, so that it/they no longer seem(s) new, strange, or difficult.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己适应于
words.ex: He can adapt himself to new situations easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能很容易地适应新情况。
words.en: To adjust one's behavior or thinking to suit a new situation or environment.

words.tr: phrase. 使自己习惯于；适应
words.ex: He accustoms himself to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己习惯早起。
words.en: To make oneself familiar with something through repeated experience.

words.tr: phrase. 从实践中积累经验
words.ex: He gathered experience from practice by working in a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在医院工作从实践中积累经验。

words.w: learn new ways of thinking and acquire problem-solving skills
words.tr: phrase. 学习新的思维方式并掌握解决问题的技能
words.ex: Students learn new ways of thinking and acquire problem-solving skills through math games.
words.ex_cn: 学生通过数学游戏学习新的思维方式并掌握解决问题的技能。

words.w: help us to influence and persuade others more effectively
words.tr: phrase. 帮助我们更有效地影响和说服他人
words.ex: Learning communication skills can help us to influence and persuade others more effectively.
words.ex_cn: 学习沟通技巧可以帮助我们更有效地影响和说服他人。

words.w: help us make new social connections
words.tr: phrase. 帮助我们建立新的社交联系
words.ex: Joining clubs can help us make new social connections.
words.ex_cn: 加入俱乐部可以帮助我们建立新的社交联系。

words.tr: phrase. 进行批判性思考
words.ex: Students must engage in critical thinking to solve complex problems.
words.ex_cn: 学生必须进行批判性思考来解决复杂问题。

words.tr: phrase. 书面作业；写作任务
words.ex: He finished his written assignments before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了他的书面作业。
words.en: Written pieces of work, such as essays, reports, or exercises, completed for study.

words.tr: phrase. 体育锻炼；身体练习；体能训练
words.ex: She does physical exercises every morning to stay fit.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上做体操以保持健康。
words.en: Physical exercises are activities performed to develop or maintain physical fitness and overall health.

words.tr: phrase. 体育活动；身体活动；体力活动
words.ex: Children should do physical activities every day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们应该每天进行体育活动。
words.en: Physical activities refer to any bodily movement produced by skeletal muscles that requires energy expenditure.

words.tr: phrase. 锻炼的生理益处
words.ex: Running every day brings the physical benefits of exercise.
words.ex_cn: 每天跑步能带来锻炼的生理益处。

words.tr: phrase. 参加课外活动
words.ex: Students participate in extracurricular activities after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后参加课外活动。

words.tr: phrase. 课外活动；放学后进行的各种活动
words.ex: He joins after-school activities every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天参加课后活动。
words.en: Activities that take place after the regular school day, often aimed at enhancing students' skills or interests outside the academic curriculum.

words.tr: phrase. 选修课；可选课程
words.ex: Students can choose optional courses each semester.
words.ex_cn: 学生每学期可以选择选修课。
words.en: Courses that students can choose to take as part of their studies, but are not required to.

words.tr: phrase. 选修课程；学生可以根据兴趣或需求自由选择的课程
words.ex: He takes elective courses in art and music.
words.ex_cn: 他选修艺术和音乐的课程。
words.en: Courses that students can choose to take as part of their studies, but are not required to take.

words.tr: n. 必修科目；必须学习的课程
words.ex: Math is a compulsory subject in all schools.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学校的必修科目。

words.tr: phrase. 必修课程
words.ex: Math is a mandatory course for all students.
words.ex_cn: 数学是所有学生的必修课。
words.en: A subject that all students are required to study as part of their education.

words.tr: phrase. 同伴压力；同辈压力
words.ex: He gave in to peer pressure and smoked cigarettes.
words.ex_cn: 他屈服于同龄人的压力，抽了香烟。
words.en: Influence from members of one's peer group.

words.tr: phrase. 与同龄人相处融洽
words.ex: Tom gets on well with peers in his class.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆和他的同龄人相处融洽。

words.w: get out of their comfort zone
words.tr: phrase. 走出舒适区
words.ex: He tried public speaking to get out of their comfort zone.
words.ex_cn: 他尝试公开演讲以走出舒适区。

words.w: the value of taking a gap year
words.tr: phrase. 间隔年的好处
words.ex: The value of taking a gap year is learning life skills before college.
words.ex_cn: 间隔年的好处是在上大学前学习生活技能。

words.w: pros and cons of studying abroad
words.tr: phrase. 留学的利与弊
words.ex: We discussed the pros and cons of studying abroad before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 我们在做决定之前讨论了留学的利与弊。

words.w: have a wealth of teaching experience
words.tr: phrase. 拥有丰富的教学经验
words.ex: She has a wealth of teaching experience from working in different schools.
words.ex_cn: 她通过在不同学校工作，拥有丰富的教学经验。

words.tr: phrase. 知识的积累与应用
words.ex: Students need knowledge accumulation and application to solve real problems.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要知识的积累与应用来解决实际问题。

words.tr: phrase. 信息访问与交换
words.ex: The system allows easy information access and exchange between users.
words.ex_cn: 该系统允许用户之间轻松访问和交换信息。

words.tr: phrase. 超出某人的能力
words.ex: Fixing this computer is beyond his capability.
words.ex_cn: 修理这台电脑超出了他的能力。

words.tr: phrase. 超出某人的能力
words.ex: The math problem was beyond his capacity.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题超出了他的能力。

words.tr: phrase. 超出某人能力范围的；力所不能及的
words.ex: This math problem is beyond my ability.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题超出了我的能力。
words.en: Exceeding one's capacity or capability

words.tr: phrase. 超出某人的能力范围
words.ex: Fixing a broken engine is beyond his competence.
words.ex_cn: 修理坏掉的发动机超出了他的能力范围。

words.w: face grave problems of diminishing funds
words.tr: phrase. 面临资金日益减少的严重问题
words.ex: The school faces grave problems of diminishing funds.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校面临资金日益减少的严重问题。

words.w: the ability to impart knowledge and command respect
words.tr: phrase. 传授知识并赢得尊重的能力
words.ex: A good teacher has the ability to impart knowledge and command respect.
words.ex_cn: 一位好老师具备传授知识并赢得尊重的能力。

words.w: show exceptional competence in solving problems
words.tr: phrase. 在解决问题方面表现出卓越的能力
words.ex: He shows exceptional competence in solving problems during math contests.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中在解决问题方面表现出卓越的能力。

words.tr: phrase. 沉浸式和体验式学习机会
words.ex: The school offers immersive and experiential learning opportunities through field trips and hands-on projects.
words.ex_cn: 学校通过实地考察和动手项目提供沉浸式和体验式学习机会。

words.w: complain about the price of college tuition fees
words.tr: phrase. 抱怨大学学费的价格
words.ex: Many students complain about the price of college tuition fees.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生抱怨大学学费的价格。

words.w: groan about the price of college tuition fees
words.tr: phrase. 抱怨大学学费的价格
words.ex: Many students groan about the price of college tuition fees.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生抱怨大学学费的价格。

words.tr: phrase. 道德感；是非感；良知
words.ex: He has a strong moral sense and always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他有强烈的道德感，总是说真话。
words.en: The innate or cultivated ability to distinguish right from wrong and make ethical judgments.

words.tr: phrase. 道德价值
words.ex: Teaching children moral values is essential for their development.
words.ex_cn: 教导孩子道德价值对他们的发展至关重要。
words.en: Moral values are principles or standards of behavior that are considered important in a society or by an individual.

words.tr: n. 道德；道义；
words.ex: He always follows his morality in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他日常生活中总是遵循自己的道德。
words.en: Morality is the belief that some behaviour is right and acceptable and that other behaviour is wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 挥洒他们的想象力
words.ex: Children love books that stretch their imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢能挥洒他们想象力的书籍。

words.w: bring out the best in students
words.tr: phrase. 激发学生的最大潜能
words.ex: Good teachers bring out the best in students by encouraging them.
words.ex_cn: 好老师通过鼓励学生来激发他们的最大潜能。

words.tr: phrase. 对知识的渴望
words.ex: Children have a desire for knowledge about the world.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们对世界充满求知欲。

words.tr: phrase. 求知欲；智力上的好奇心；对知识的热切渴望
words.ex: Her intellectual curiosity led her to explore various scientific fields.
words.ex_cn: 她的求知欲使她探索了各种科学领域。
words.en: A strong desire to know or learn something.

words.tr: phrase. 激发学生的求知欲
words.ex: The teacher used fun experiments to stimulate students' intellectual curiosity.
words.ex_cn: 老师用有趣的实验来激发学生的求知欲。

words.tr: phrase. 培养学生的自信心
words.ex: Teachers should foster students' self-confidence by praising their efforts.
words.ex_cn: 老师应该通过表扬学生的努力来培养他们的自信心。

words.tr: phrase. 努力做某事
words.ex: He makes efforts to learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力学习英语。
words.en: To try hard to do something.

words.w: make every effort to do sth
words.tr: phrase. 尽一切努力做某事；竭尽全力去做某事
words.uk: meɪk ˈevri ˈefət tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: meɪk ˈevri ˈefərt tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He makes every effort to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他尽全力完成作业。
words.en: To try as hard as possible to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 努力做某事；试图完成某事
words.ex: He endeavor to do his best in every task.
words.ex_cn: 他努力在每项任务中做到最好。
words.en: to try hard to do or achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 教学方法；教学途径
words.ex: Different teaching approaches can be used to cater to various learning styles.
words.ex_cn: n. 不同的教学方法可以用来适应各种学习风格。
words.en: Teaching approaches refer to the methods and strategies used by educators to facilitate learning and instruction.

words.tr: phrase. 教学方法；教授方式
words.ex: The school uses new teaching methods to help students learn better.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用新的教学方法来帮助学生学得更好。
words.en: Teaching methods refer to the principles and methods used for instruction. They are the strategies and techniques that teachers use to impart knowledge to students.

words.tr: phrase. 教学法；教育学方法论；教学体系的理论与实践方法
words.ex: The teacher uses simple pedagogical methodology to help students learn.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师使用简单的教学方法帮助学生学习。
words.en: Pedagogical methodology refers to the principles and methods of instruction used in teaching.

words.tr: phrase. 培养良好的学习技能
words.ex: Students should develop good study skills to do better in exams.
words.ex_cn: 学生应该培养良好的学习技能，以便在考试中取得更好的成绩。

words.tr: n. 研究领域
words.ex: He works in the research field of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 他从事人工智能的研究领域。
words.en: A specific area of academic or scientific study and investigation.

words.tr: n. 研究领域
words.ex: He works in the research domain of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 他在人工智能研究领域工作。
words.en: A specific area of study or expertise within a broader academic or professional field.

words.tr: phrase. 身体发育；体格发展；生理成长
words.ex: Regular exercise is crucial for the physical development of children.
words.ex_cn: n. 定期锻炼对儿童的身体发展至关重要。
words.en: Physical development refers to the growth of the body and the development of motor skills, as well as the changes in the body's physical capabilities.

words.tr: phrase. 生理生长
words.ex: Children show rapid physiological growth during puberty.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在青春期表现出快速的生理生长。

words.tr: phrase. 心理发展；智力发展；心智发育
words.ex: Reading helps children's mental development.
words.ex_cn: 阅读有助于儿童的心理发展。
words.en: The process of developing the mind, including aspects like cognition, emotion, and social skills.

words.tr: phrase. 心智成长；精神成长；心理发展
words.ex: Reading books helps mental growth in children.
words.ex_cn: 读书有助于儿童的心理成长。
words.en: The process of advancing one's cognitive abilities and mental capacities.

words.tr: phrase. 心理成熟
words.ex: He shows mental maturity when he stays calm under pressure.
words.ex_cn: 当他能在压力下保持冷静时，就表现出心理成熟。

words.tr: phrase. 对某事的适应能力
words.ex: His adaptability to new work environments helped him succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他对新工作环境的适应能力帮助他取得了成功。

words.w: be prepared to adapt to the changing world
words.tr: phrase. 做好准备适应不断变化的世界
短语. 能够做某事；有能力完成某事
words.ex: He is able to swim across the river.
words.ex_cn: 他能游过这条河。
words.en: To have the necessary ability, knowledge, or skill to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 能够做某事的；有做某事能力的
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: To have the ability, power, or means to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 新信息；最新情报；新资料
words.ex: He received new information about the project.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了关于这个项目的新信息。
words.en: Recently acquired facts, data, or knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 已更新的信息；最新的资料
words.ex: The website has updated information about the event.
words.ex_cn: 该网站提供了有关该活动的最新信息。
words.en: New or recently revised data, facts, or knowledge that reflects the current state of affairs.

words.tr: phrase. 最新的信息；最新资料
words.ex: We need up-to-date information to make a decision.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要最新信息来做决定。
words.en: The most recent information available.

words.tr: phrase. 学生辍学率
words.ex: The drop-out rates of students have increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年学生的辍学率上升了。

words.tr: phrase. 来自；起源于
words.ex: His love of music stems from his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的热爱源于他的童年。
words.en: If a condition or problem stems from something, it was caused originally by that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 起源；由…引起
words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To come from a particular place or start in a particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 由...产生；产生于
words.ex: His illness resulted from poor diet and lack of sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他的疾病是由饮食不良和睡眠不足引起的。
words.en: to be caused by something; to happen or exist because of something

words.tr: phrase. 校园暴力
words.ex: The school is trying to stop campus violence.
words.ex_cn: 学校正努力制止校园暴力。
words.en: Violent or aggressive acts that occur within a school or university campus.

words.tr: phrase. 学校体育馆
words.ex: The students play basketball in a school gymnasium.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在学校体育馆打篮球。

words.tr: phrase. 团队运动；指需要多名队员协作进行的体育项目，如足球、篮球等
words.ex: He loves playing team sports with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢和朋友们一起玩团队运动。
words.en: Team sports are sports in which individuals are organized into opposing teams which compete to win. Examples include football, basketball, and hockey.

words.tr: phrase. 参加竞技体育
words.ex: He partakes in competitive sport every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都参加竞技体育。

words.tr: phrase. 使学生分心，偏离学业
words.ex: Too much noise can distract students from their studies.
words.ex_cn: 太多噪音会使学生分心，偏离学业。

words.tr: phrase. 健康的竞争；良性竞争（指在积极、公平的环境下促进进步的竞争）
words.ex: The healthy competition between students improves their learning.
words.ex_cn: 学生之间健康的竞争提高了他们的学习效果。
words.en: Competition that is constructive and promotes well-being.

words.tr: phrase. 恶性竞争
words.ex: The two companies engaged in malicious competition to destroy each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司进行了恶性竞争以摧毁对方。

words.tr: phrase. 精神崩溃
words.ex: He had a mental breakdown after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后精神崩溃了。

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 精神压力
words.ex: He felt mental pressure before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到精神压力。

words.tr: phrase. 盲目追随
words.ex: Don't blindly follow trends just because others do.
words.ex_cn: 不要只是因为别人这么做就盲目追随潮流。

words.tr: phrase. 不愿思考
n. 职业导向；职业生涯方向指导
words.ex: He is exploring his career orientation before graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他在毕业前探索自己的职业方向。
words.en: The process of exploring and choosing a professional path.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏实践经验；缺少实际操作经验
words.ex: He lacks practical experience in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他在工程方面缺乏实践经验。
words.en: To lack practical, hands-on skills or knowledge gained through direct involvement in activities.

words.tr: phrase. 为期一天的迎新培训会
words.ex: New students attended a one-day orientation session before classes started.
words.ex_cn: 新生在课程开始前参加了一场为期一天的迎新培训会。

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏自律；缺少自我约束
words.ex: He eats too much candy because he lacks self-discipline.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多糖果，因为他缺乏自制力。
words.en: Fail to control impulses or follow routines consistently.

words.tr: phrase. 缺乏自制力；无法自我控制
words.ex: He tends to lack self-control when he's angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时往往缺乏自制力。
words.en: To not have the ability to control one's emotions, desires, or behaviors.

words.tr: phrase. 认为…优先
words.ex: The school gives priority to students who need extra help.
words.ex_cn: 学校优先照顾需要额外帮助的学生。
words.en: To treat something as more important than others.

words.tr: phrase. 重视
words.ex: He attaches importance to homework.
words.ex_cn: 他重视家庭作业。
words.en: To consider something as important or to give special attention to it.

words.tr: phrase. 强调；着重于
words.ex: The teacher lays accent on practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天练习。

words.tr: phrase. 强调；着重于；把重点放在
words.ex: Schools should place emphasis on reading and writing.
words.ex_cn: 学校应该重视读写能力。
words.en: To give special importance or attention to something.

words.tr: phrase. 对……给予重大重视
words.ex: The school places significant emphasis on math and science.
words.ex_cn: 学校对数学和科学给予重大重视。

words.tr: adj. 全面的；丰满的
words.ex: He is a well-rounded student who likes sports, music, and math.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个全面发展的好学生，喜欢运动、音乐和数学。
words.en: If you describe someone as well-rounded, you mean that they have a personality which is fully developed in all aspects.

words.tr: adj. 全面的；多才多艺的
words.ex: He is an all-rounded student who excels in sports, music, and math.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名全面发展的学生，在体育、音乐和数学方面都很优秀。
words.en: Having a wide range of abilities or skills; versatile.

words.w: have a lower probability of unemployment
words.tr: phrase. 失业概率较低
words.ex: People with a college degree have a lower probability of unemployment.
words.ex_cn: 拥有大学学位的人失业概率较低。

words.tr: phrase. 初等教育
words.ex: He completed primary education in his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 他在家乡完成了小学教育。
words.en: Primary education refers to the first stage of formal education, coming after preschool and before secondary education. It is typically provided to children aged between 5 and 11.

words.tr: phrase. 初等教育；基础教育（通常指小学阶段的教育）
words.ex: He teaches elementary education to young children.
words.ex_cn: 他给小孩子教授初等教育。
words.en: Elementary education refers to the first stage of formal education, usually including grades one through six or eight, focusing on basic academic learning and socialization skills.

words.tr: phrase. 大学教育；高等教育
words.ex: He wants to finish college education and become a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他想完成大学教育，成为一名老师。
words.en: Education provided by a college or university, typically leading to a degree.

words.tr: phrase. 大学教育；高等教育
words.ex: He wants to get university education in engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他想接受工程方面的大学教育。
words.en: Education received at a university, typically leading to a bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree.

words.tr: phrase. 高等教育
words.ex: He wants to go to higher education after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后接受高等教育。
words.en: Higher education refers to the level of study that is undertaken at universities, colleges, and institutes of technology, beyond the level of secondary education.

words.tr: phrase. 职业教育
words.ex: He is learning vocational education to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习职业教育，以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Vocational education is education that prepares people to work in various jobs, such as a trade, a craft, or as a technician. Vocational education is sometimes referred to as career and technical education.

words.w: the high-level skills necessary for the labor market
words.tr: phrase. 劳动力市场所需的高级技能
words.ex: Students need to learn the high-level skills necessary for the labor market.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要学习劳动力市场所需的高级技能。

words.tr: n.大学生
words.ex: Undergraduates are learning basic math this semester.
words.ex_cn: 本科生这学期正在学习基础数学。
words.en: Undergraduates are students at a university or college who are studying for their first degree.

words.tr: phrase. 大学毕业生
words.ex: Many college graduates find jobs quickly.
words.ex_cn: 许多大学毕业生很快找到了工作。
words.en: Individuals who have successfully completed a university or college degree program.

words.tr: phrase. 大学毕业生
words.ex: Many university graduates find jobs quickly.
words.ex_cn: 许多大学毕业生很快找到了工作。
words.en: Individuals who have successfully completed a degree at a university.

words.w: the efficacy of a college degree
words.tr: phrase. 大学学位的有效性
words.ex: Many people question the efficacy of a college degree in today's job market.
words.ex_cn: 许多人质疑大学学位在当今就业市场中的有效性。

words.w: a serious wage gap between those with and without a degree
words.tr: phrase. 拥有学位者与没有学位者之间严重的工资差距
words.ex: There is a serious wage gap between those with and without a degree.
words.ex_cn: 拥有学位者与没有学位者之间存在严重的工资差距。

words.tr: phrase. 有效地表达你的想法
words.ex: Try to communicate your ideas effectively in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 试着在会议上有效地表达你的想法。

words.tr: phrase. 提高效率；提升效率
words.ex: The company implemented new strategies to increase efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 公司实施了新策略以提高效率。
words.en: To make a process or system work better and produce more with less effort or resources.

words.tr: v. 提高效率
words.ex: The new machine helps raise efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器有助于提高效率。
words.en: Increase the effectiveness or productivity of a process.

words.tr: phrase. 获得工作经验
words.ex: He got an internship to obtain work experience.
words.ex_cn: 他找了一份实习来获得工作经验。

words.tr: phrase. 获得工作经验；通过实际工作积累职业经历
words.ex: He wants to gain work experience during summer break.
words.ex_cn: 他想在暑假期间获得工作经验。
words.en: To acquire practical knowledge and skills through employment in a specific field.

words.tr: phrase. 获得工作经验
words.ex: He interned at a company to acquire work experience.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家公司实习以获得工作经验。

words.tr: phrase. 出国学习
words.ex: He wants to study abroad next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年去国外学习。
words.en: To study in a foreign country, typically for a period of time as part of one's education.

words.tr: phrase. 出国留学：指学生到国外的学校或大学进行学习和深造的行为。
words.ex: He wants to study overseas next year.
words.ex_cn: 他想明年去国外学习。
words.en: Study overseas: To pursue education in a foreign country, typically for a semester or longer.

words.tr: phrase. 出国深造
words.ex: He plans to go abroad for further study after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他计划毕业后出国深造。

words.tr: phrase. 到国外学习的机会
words.ex: He got the opportunity to study abroad last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了到国外学习的机会。

words.tr: phrase. 外语熟练程度
words.ex: His foreign language proficiency helped him get the job.
words.ex_cn: 他的外语熟练程度帮助他得到了这份工作。

words.w: gain professional qualifications that are recognized and respected worldwide
words.tr: phrase. 获得全球公认且受尊重的专业资格
words.ex: He studied hard to gain professional qualifications that are recognized and respected worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，以获得全球公认且受尊重的专业资格。

words.w: establish an enjoyable career of your choice
words.tr: phrase. 建立自己喜爱的职业
words.ex: He wants to establish an enjoyable career of his choice as a musician.
words.ex_cn: 他想建立自己喜爱的职业，成为一名音乐家。

words.tr: phrase. 有特殊教育需求的学生
words.ex: The teacher helps pupils with special educational needs in small groups.
words.ex_cn: 老师在小组中帮助有特殊教育需求的学生。

words.w: a young woman of impressive educational attainments
words.tr: phrase. 一位教育成就卓著的年轻女性
words.ex: She is a young woman of impressive educational attainments, having graduated from Harvard with honors.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位教育成就卓著的年轻女性，以优异成绩从哈佛大学毕业。

words.w: have the highest level of educational attainment
words.tr: phrase. 具有最高的教育水平
words.ex: He have the highest level of educational attainment in his family.
words.ex_cn: 他在家里具有最高的教育水平。

words.tr: phrase. 改革教育体系
words.ex: The government wants to reform the educational system to help all students.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望改革教育体系以帮助所有学生。

words.tr: phrase. 平等的教育机会；指每个人无论背景如何，都应享有同等接受教育的权利和条件
words.ex: All children should have equal educational opportunity.
words.ex_cn: 所有孩子都应该享有平等的教育机会。
words.en: The principle that all individuals should have the same access to educational resources and opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 教师短缺
words.ex: The shortage of teachers makes classes bigger.
words.ex_cn: 教师短缺导致班级人数变多。

words.tr: phrase. 互动式教学方法；通过师生、生生双向或多向交流来促进学习的教学方式
words.ex: The teacher uses interactive teaching methods to help students learn faster.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用互动教学方法帮助学生更快地学习。
words.en: Interactive teaching methods

words.tr: phrase. 死记硬背；机械记忆
words.ex: Students learn by rote in some traditional schools.
words.ex_cn: 在一些传统学校里，学生通过死记硬背来学习。
words.en: To learn something by repeating it many times without thinking about it or understanding it.

words.tr: phrase. 受正规教育很少
words.ex: He have little formal schooling but is very smart.
words.ex_cn: 他受正规教育很少，但非常聪明。

words.w: motivate students to seek more knowledge
words.tr: phrase. 激励学生寻求更多知识
words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to seek more knowledge.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生寻求更多知识。

words.w: encourage the full development of a student's talents
words.tr: phrase. 鼓励学生全面发展才能
words.ex: The school encourages the full development of a student's talents through art and sports.
words.ex_cn: 学校通过艺术和体育鼓励学生全面发展才能。

words.w: galvanize the students into studying hard
words.tr: phrase. 激励学生努力学习
words.ex: The teacher's speech galvanized the students into studying hard.
words.ex_cn: 老师的演讲激励学生努力学习。

words.tr: phrase. 对某事关注不足
words.ex: He paid insufficient attention to his homework and failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业关注不足，结果考试没及格。

words.tr: phrase. 特别注意某事
words.ex: Pay particular attention to the math problems.
words.ex_cn: 特别注意这些数学题。

words.tr: phrase. 限制儿童的屏幕使用时间
words.ex: Parents should limit children's screen time to one hour a day.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该将儿童的屏幕使用时间限制在每天一小时。

words.w: get away from the television or computer screen
words.tr: phrase. 远离电视或电脑屏幕
words.ex: Children should get away from the television or computer screen to protect their eyes.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们应该远离电视或电脑屏幕以保护眼睛。

words.tr: phrase. 电脑游戏；电子游戏
words.ex: He plays computer games every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上玩电脑游戏。
words.en: Computer games are games played on a computer, either alone or with others, for entertainment.

words.tr: phrase. 一种久坐不动的生活方式
words.ex: He has a sedentary lifestyle because he sits at a desk all day.
words.ex_cn: 他整天坐在办公桌前，过着久坐不动的生活。
words.en: A sedentary lifestyle: A way of life involving little physical activity or exercise.

words.w: a growing number of children are overweight
words.tr: phrase. 超重儿童的数量日益增加
words.ex: A growing number of children are overweight because they eat too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 由于吃太多垃圾食品，超重儿童的数量日益增加。

words.tr: phrase. 导致肥胖
words.ex: Eating too much sugar can lead to obesity.
words.ex_cn: 吃太多糖会导致肥胖。
words.en: To result in a condition of excessive body fat.

words.tr: phrase. 降低学龄儿童的肥胖率
words.ex: The school lunch program helps reduce obesity in school children.
words.ex_cn: 学校的午餐计划有助于降低学龄儿童的肥胖率。

words.tr: n. 沙发土豆（指长时间懒散地坐在沙发上看电视的人）
words.ex: They sit all day and watch TV; they are couch potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他们整天坐着看电视，是沙发土豆。
words.en: People who spend a lot of time sitting or lying down, often watching television and being inactive.

words.tr: phrase. 暴力场景
words.ex: The movie showed scenes of violence that made people feel uncomfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了让人感到不舒服的暴力场景。

words.tr: phrase. 电影中的暴力
words.ex: The violence in films often scares young children.
words.ex_cn: 电影中的暴力经常吓到小孩子。

words.tr: phrase. 鼓励儿童的攻击行为
words.ex: Parents should not encourage aggression in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母不应鼓励儿童的攻击行为。

words.tr: phrase. 大多数父母
words.ex: The majority of parents want their children to be healthy.
words.ex_cn: 大多数父母希望他们的孩子健康。

words.tr: n. 繁忙的工作日程；紧张忙碌的工作安排
words.ex: He has hectic work schedules every week.
